newsitem.title: USA: Denbury Resources YR Dec 31 full results.
newsitem.headline: Denbury Resources YR Dec 31 full results.

text.p: (Amounts in thousands of U.S. dollars) 1996 1995 Change

Note: (A) Exclusive of the net change in non-cash working capital balances. Denbury continued to increase its average daily production with 8,167 barrels of oil equivalent per day ("BOE/d") during 1996 as compared to 4,207 BOE/d for 1995 (94% increase) with production currently at approximately 11,200 BOE/d.

As a result of the increased production and improved product prices cash floww from operations increased 263% over 1995 levels and net income increased from $714 thousand ($0.10 per share) during 1995 to $8.7 million ($.67 per share) for 1996.
The Company is pleased to report an 91% increase in its proven oil and gas reserves during the year to 27.4 million BOE's as of December 31, 1996.

The present value of the proven reserves increased 226% to approximately $3166 million, calculated in accordance with SEC requirements on an unescalated basis using a 10% discount rate and year end prices based on a West Texas Intermediate ("WTI") price of $23.39 per Bbl and a NYMEX Henry Hub price of $3.90 per MMBtu with these prices, adjusted by field.

The Company also prepared an unescalated price case using a WTI price of $21.00 per Bbl and a NYMEX price of $2.40 per MMBtu, which yielded a present value of $214 million. The reserves were estimated by Netherland, Sewell and Associates, an independent engineering firm located in Dallas, Texas.
Denbury is a natural resource company with its primary operations in the states of Louisiana and Mississippi.
The Toronto Stock Exchange and the SEC have neither approved nor disapproved the information contained herein.
Note: Full company name is Denbury Resources Inc.
